files.scenario/scenario.md:
# Superpowers dispatch reliability

Run this package only with the external executor in
`examples/superpowers-workflow-reliability/cli.py`.
It executes one approved declared Plan task in a disposable Git worktree, checks dispatch
prerequisites, records a real child process and verifies enumerable coverage.
The six JSON outputs contain measured receipts.

The YAML defines graph dependencies and required artifacts. The accompanying
executor owns the pre-dispatch and completion checks. Loading this package into
another host does not intercept that host's tools. Model identity is recorded only
when observable; a requested model name is not proof of the backend model.

Steps: `prepare` generates the brief and observable Todo; `validate_dispatch`
checks actual prerequisites; `dispatch` rechecks and starts the child; `collect`
retains execution evidence; `validate_completion` checks coverage and tests;
`record` marks the task complete.
files.scenario/state.yml:
initial: __start__
transitions:
  __start__: [{to: prepare}]
  prepare: [{to: validate_dispatch}]
  validate_dispatch: [{to: dispatch}]
  dispatch: [{to: collect}]
  collect: [{to: validate_completion}]
  validate_completion: [{to: record}]
  record: [{to: __end__}]
steps:
  prepare:
    label: Prepare task
    prompt: Prepare the approved declared task using the guarded example executor. Save the actual brief-generation receipt, base SHA and Todo event as preparation.
    outputs: [{material: preparation, required: true}]
    acceptance_criteria: Receipt contains the observed nonempty brief hash, task id, expected base SHA and recorded in_progress event.
  validate_dispatch:
    label: Validate dispatch preconditions
    prompt: Use the deterministic executor to inspect the prepared files and actual Git HEAD. Save admission only when every dispatch check passes.
    inputs: [{material: preparation, required: true}]
    outputs: [{material: admission, required: true}]
    acceptance_criteria: All actual prerequisites pass; absent evidence must fail the attempt.
  dispatch:
    label: Dispatch SubAgent
    prompt: The guarded executor must revalidate admission immediately before starting one real Codex implementer. Save execution only after successful process completion.
    inputs: [{material: admission, required: true}]
    outputs: [{material: execution, required: true}]
    acceptance_criteria: A real child was started after revalidation and returned zero with a terminal turn completion.
  collect:
    label: Collect execution evidence
    prompt: Collect real trace hashes, Git diff, child report and coverage checklist without substituting a model summary for raw evidence.
    inputs: [{material: execution, required: true}]
    outputs: [{material: evidence, required: true}]
    acceptance_criteria: Evidence links the actual execution to the resulting files.
  validate_completion:
    label: Validate completion
    prompt: Check every declared coverage id and run the unchanged declared acceptance tests using the deterministic executor. Reject missing, duplicate or skipped coverage for complete success.
    inputs: [{material: evidence, required: true}]
    outputs: [{material: completion, required: true}]
    acceptance_criteria: The exact coverage set is DONE, fixed tests are unchanged and all pass.
  record:
    label: Record result
    prompt: Record final success and completed Todo only after all completion checks have succeeded.
    inputs: [{material: completion, required: true}]
    outputs: [{material: result, required: true}]
    acceptance_criteria: Final status and observable Todo both agree with validated execution.
